overall_assessment: Extraction is faithful for courses that have a plan on the page: all accordion sections, learning outcomes, exam text and the facts box are captured, with no site chrome. The 11 'short' suspects are pages that carry no plan at all (discontinued or not taught for 5 years), so the text is only title, code, overlap list and credits. Minor issues: duplicated lead paragraph, duplicated overlap entries, one mojibake character.

findings.description: Pages for discontinued or untaught courses hold no plan (the page says 'Dette faget har ikke hatt undervisning de siste 5 år'), so extracted_text is only title, code, an overlap list and credits (28-600 chars). These records are not plans, yet they sit in the data as offerings with text. The short flag (58 of 3489, about 1.7%) is a true positive but the cause is the source, not the selector.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Nord shows a stub page for courses without a current plan; selector div.node__content correctly returns only what is there. Nothing in the pipeline marks these as 'no plan'.
findings.suggested_fix: Flag such offerings as no-plan (for example when extracted text has no Beskrivelse/Læringsutbytte/Eksamensbeskrivelse heading, or the page contains 'har ikke hatt undervisning de siste 5 år') and exclude them from the course_plan frame or list them in the gaps target.

findings.description: For old offerings (2016-2018) the year/semester URL parameter does not select a historical plan: the page shows the current plan ('sist oppdatert 2026/27') or a stub. MA131L 2018 has a real plan text but the page header says it is the current description, so the text may not be the 2018 plan. Courses with a matching year label ('Emnebeskrivelse for 2023/24', 'sist oppdatert 2019/20') are fine, so this affects older/outdated offerings only.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: plan_years = url relies on ?year=&semester= which Nord ignores when no plan version exists for that year, falling back to the latest.
findings.suggested_fix: Capture the 'Emnebeskrivelse for YYYY/YY' or 'sist oppdatert' label from the page, store it as plan year, and compare it with the offering year; mark mismatches as wrong-year or no-plan.

findings.evidence:
Beskrivelse av emnet
Dette emnet gir generell kjennskap til ulike tema innenfor internasjonale relasjoner.
findings.description: The lead summary under the title is repeated (near-verbatim) under 'Beskrivelse av emnet', so the description appears twice. Also the overlap list can repeat entries (HI109NS twice in HI109LS, HI118NS twice in HI118LS).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The page has an ingress block and the accordion body with the same text; both are inside div.node__content.
findings.suggested_fix: Deduplicate: drop the ingress paragraph when it equals the start of the Beskrivelse section, and dedupe identical lines in the Overlappende emner list.

findings.evidence: kartlegging og utredning av elever med sosiale ¿ og emosjonelle vansker
findings.description: A character was mangled to '¿' (probably a dash or quote in the source). Single instance in the packet; only a cosmetic encoding issue.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Source page encoding or an earlier conversion of the course text.
findings.suggested_fix: Check whether the raw html holds the character; if so, map '¿' between spaces to a dash in post_fn; otherwise ignore.
